matching.recommended: Match to an episode opening on the same mother/wealthy-father relationship and the son's impending marriage; prioritize entity roles and causal continuity over wardrobe or face similarity.
requiredChecks: Compare against original-drama source around the first mother/father encounter.
Verify whether the hook summarizes future plot or is unrelated promotional material.

transitionRecommendations.direct: Preferred only if the episode begins with the wealthy father's introduction or the immediate aftermath of the collapsed-girl encounter; cut on the dialogue handoff around 39-50s after frame review.
transitionRecommendations.A: If the episode opens earlier in the mother's hardship arc, transition after the savings/sacrifice beat using a short contextual bridge.
transitionRecommendations.B: If the episode opens later at the romance, retain the wealthy-father reveal and use a brief recap/title bridge before the episode scene.
transitionRecommendations.avoid: Do not claim an exact splice or source subtype without original-drama comparison.

rejectOrDegradeConditions: Reject as a match if the target episode has no mother/son/wealthy-father causal chain.
Degrade boundary confidence if frame-accurate review places the narration-to-scene transition before 39s or after 50s.
Keep source subtype pending unless original source comparison proves reuse, unrelatedness, or mixing.
Do not reject an external hook solely because people, wardrobe, or visual style remain continuous.
